newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary Oct PPI up 1.6 pct m/m, 20 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Hungary Oct PPI up 1.6 pct m/m, 20 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Producer prices in Hungary rose by 1.6 percent in October from the previous month and were up 20 percent from a year ago, the Central Statistics Office (KSH) said in a statement on Wednesday.
In Septemberm, the monthly rise was 1.4 percent while the year-on-year rise was 20.4 percent.
NOTE - Domestic sales prices rose 1.4 percent in October over the previous month, while export prices gained 1.9 percent.
Domestic sales prices in October rose 21 percent from the same month of 1995, while export prices increased 17.3 percent.
Utility prices rose by 0.4 percent over the previous month and were up 21.3 percent year-on-year.
Mining industrial price levels were 1.6-percent above September and up 16.5 percent year-on-year.
In October, the rise in manufacturing prices dominated increases with a 1.6-percent jump.

Prices grew by 2.5 percent in the food, beverage and tobacco industry and by 2.3 percent in the chemicals industry. Year-on-year rises in these areas were between 27 and 28 percent, the statistical office said.
